patterns.what_was_hard: NuGet TLS handshake failure prevented restore; GitHub authentication prevented publication.
patterns.what_worked: Authoritative CG recommendation matched the installed replacement SDK; only the SDK pin changed.
patterns.environment_blockers: NU1301 HandshakeFailure; noninteractive GitHub credentials unavailable.

outcome.changes_proposed: Update the .NET SDK pin from 10.0.401 to the CG recommended 10.0.403.
outcome.full_journey: Developer supplied a CG alert; no S360 query was needed. Dedicated dependency orchestration ran environment probe, alert retrieval, triage, repository analysis, SDK remediation and SDK configuration. CG recommended 10.0.403. A single SDK pin was changed in [repo] on a working branch. JSON and diff checks passed and SDK resolution returned the fixed version. Build required restore, which failed with a TLS handshake error; tests and independent validation were not reached. Push authentication was unavailable. No remediation commit or PR was created. Developer skipped optional feedback.
